name: deepx_rapid_storyboard_autopilot
description: Fully Autonomous Multi-Scene Storyboard Engine: Single-command complete production. Takes any script (Hindi, English, etc.) or raw narrative and executes end-to-end with 100% strict fidelity to user data: automatically segments scenes while preserving user actions and dialogue, detects and locks protagonist reference cards, renders video, extracts terminal frame on canvas (~30ms), chains scenes, and auto-downloads without human intervention. FAST-PATH: Call immediately without interviewing the user.

auto_breakdown.description: If true, automatically analyzes unstructured raw text to segment scenes, isolate protagonist entities, and formulate cinematic prompts with @mention tags while preserving user story text.

auto_download.description: If true, automatically downloads finished scenes to Chrome Downloads folder.

duration.description: Duration per scene in seconds (5, 8, or 10).

hero_references.description: Protagonist/hero character, vehicle, animal, or product reference names (e.g. ['tesla_roadster', 'cyber_samurai']) to lock into EVERY scene. Compulsory for character consistency unless user explicitly asked for no references.

no_references.description: Set true ONLY if user explicitly instructed not to use reference characters or images.

raw_input.description: Alias for script_text: user's raw story, script, bullet points, or Hindi script to be faithfully visualized in multi-scene production.

script_text.description: Complete storyboard script with scenes separated by blank lines (or gaps). If provided, user's exact scenes and story are preserved 100% without alteration.
